# BMJ Blogs

> A comprehensive hub of evidence-based medical blogs and journals covering clinical practice, research, and healthcare leadership across specialty areas.

BMJ Blogs aggregates content from BMJ's portfolio of peer-reviewed journals and editorial platforms, providing clinicians, researchers, and healthcare professionals with curated insights on medical research, clinical practice, and professional development. The platform covers diverse specialties from global health and mental health to sports medicine and palliative care.

## Key Topics

- BMJ
- Open-access publishing
- Evidence-based medicine
- Clinical practice
- Medical research
- Global health
- Medical education
- Healthcare leadership
- Research integrity
- Palliative care
- Gastroenterology
- Mental health
- Injury prevention
- COVID-19
- Journal hub

## Core Editorial Platforms

- [BMJ Blogs Homepage](https://blogs.bmj.com): BMJ Blogs homepage directing to medical specialty blogs and journals.
- [BMJ Opinion](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmj): BMJ opinion pieces and editorial content platform.

## Open-Access Research Journals

- [BMJ Open](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmjopen): Medical research blog with editor's top picks and open-access highlights.
- [BMJ Case Reports](https://blogs.bmj.com/case-reports): Official BMJ Case Reports blog discussing medical progress and clinical implications.
- [BMJ Open Science](https://blogs.bmj.com/openscience): Preclinical research blog on research integrity and reproducibility.
- [BMJ Open Gastroenterology](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmjopengastro): Gastroenterology research summaries and clinical articles blog.

## Specialty Clinical Journals

- [BMJ Global Health](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmjgh): Global health discussion and debate on public health policy and health equity.
- [Evidence-Based Mental Health](https://blogs.bmj.com/ebmh): Evidence-based mental health blog for psychiatrists and psychologists.
- [BMJ Sexual & Reproductive Health](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmjsrh): Sexual and reproductive health blog for contraception and clinical professionals.
- [BMJ Supportive & Palliative Care](https://blogs.bmj.com/spcare): Supportive and palliative care journal blog on end-of-life and cancer care.
- [Frontline Gastroenterology](https://blogs.bmj.com/fg): Gastroenterology and hepatology best practice blog for clinical professionals.

## Professional Development & Leadership

- [BMJ Leader](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmjleader): Healthcare leadership blog covering NHS systems and organizational improvement.
- [ADC Online Blog](https://blogs.bmj.com/adc): Evidence-based blog on child health education, debate and clinical research.
- [Evidence-Based Nursing](https://blogs.bmj.com/ebn): Evidence-based nursing blog on clinical practice and professional development.

## Specialty Research & Prevention

- [BMJ Open Sport & Exercise Medicine](https://blogs.bmj.com/bmjopensem): Sports medicine and exercise research blog on injury prevention and performance.
- [Injury Prevention](https://blogs.bmj.com/injury-prevention): Injury prevention and safety promotion research and conference coverage blog.
